notes.detail: I really like reading fiction novels and books, especially mystery and science fiction, I always like a good dystopian story. I also enjoy hanging out with my friends which, although a classic, might be my favorite way to spend time. Furthermore, I also like learning and building projects, I am interested in learning robotics and product design so I can build things recreationally. I also love drawing and watching movies and shows, I am a Letterboxd amateur.

I would say I approach problems systematically, in a roadmap style. Every time I have to solve a new challenge, I always break it down into the smallest pieces, and create a generic solution skeleton, which I then adapt to multiple ideas. I often contact a lot of friends and colleagues for feedback on the different ideas and then decide the final track I will continue. Therefore, I always have the problem perfectly defined before actually starting with the solution.

I really enjoy the process of solving complex problems and, even more, creating creative solutions. I consider myself a really creative person, and I found in data science and AI the possibility to create endless projects and products, and pretty much make anything I can think of. I also want my future job to be rewarding and fulfilling, and I find a future in which my job tackles that creative side of me an objective in life.
